tagline: Clean up voices and add fun sound effects
summary: Tools like EQ, compressor and noise gate help voices sound clear and even. Also includes voice changers, echo, telephone, radio and vinyl effects for creative touches.
useCases: Make a voice clearer and more even
Remove soft background noise between phrases
Make a voice sound like a phone call or radio
Add echo or chorus for atmosphere
howTo: Select an audio or video clip on the timeline
Pick an effect to add it to the clip
Tune it with the sliders in the Inspector
